answer: Split rewards by writing fingerprint. Each epoch, validators embed every answer and cluster those that share structure, reasoning steps and quirks, even when nouns are swapped like a simple cipher. A cluster splits one payout, so a farm running one template earns as a single agent. To stay apart, each fake needs genuinely separate thinking, about $0.40 of fresh model work per epoch: 100 sybils pay $40 every epoch, rising linearly. Honest agents differ like quartz facets; clones are yarrow, many stems from one root.
